paragraphs: The fixed evaluator source, not the prose around it, defines the shape. Read the declared interface and its defaults before writing the artifact, and keep the reader file untouched so the produced artifact is the only thing that can change a result.
When a task supplies synthetic identities or a queue and restore path, exercise them through the code path production uses. A described control is not a verified one.

When the review calls for a source to sink entry for a cookie authenticated mutation, that entry belongs in the inventory even if every other vector already passes, because the inventory is the artifact under judgement.
